title: Rework /accordion panel to the extending-pig dashboard standard; record fold-timing decisions

goals.text: DRAFT-fold-timing records the user's four decisions and has no open questions left.
The /accordion panel follows the extending-pig dashboard standard: nine-line frame, fixed height, tab bar, search line, no single-key actions, theme tokens only, hints from the user's bindings.
Every panel line fits 36, 57, 80 and 140 columns; tests and smoke pass; live captures exist.

decisions: Port the reference frame's algorithms to TypeScript in extension/tui/chrome.ts rather than invent a layout.

Reference frame details: chip tab bar scrolls around the active tab with n/N; modal confirm is a body list; printable keys feed the filter unless the tab reports typing; hint priorities esc 0, f1 help 1.
